bullets.title: AMD: 80%+ FY27 guidance, DC +97% YoY — analysts bullish with avg PT $654
bullets.body: AMD Q3 EPS $2.09 beat by $0.14, revenue $13.38B +2.1% above consensus; Data Center revenue $8.55B +97% y/y. Q4 guided ~$17B (+4.4% above consensus). FY27 guidance calls for >80% revenue growth, server CPU >100%, DCAI materially >100%; MI455X/Helios ramping with MI500 multi-GW deployments. 83% Buy, avg PT $654.57 implying 35% upside; Wells Fargo PT $650, Cantor $700, BMO $550, RBC $540 Sector Perform.

bullets.title: ANET: 2027 guide +38-40%, TAM doubles to $220B — MS raises PT to $230
bullets.body: ANET FQ3 revenue $3.658B, +10% beat vs consensus, 58.5% y/y growth; 49.1% operating margin. 2027 guidance +38-40% y/y with AI fabrics expected to double to ~$7B; campus growing +60% to $2B. Morgan Stanley raises PT to $230 from $220 (Overweight); JPM's Cardoso raises FY26/27 EPS +6.5%/+11% and PT to $270.

bullets.title: ALAB: Scorpio crosses $1B+ run-rate, Q4 guide $730-750M massively above consensus
bullets.body: ALAB Q3 beat by $35M vs consensus; Q4 guided $730-750M (+27% QoQ) vs consensus $659M. Scorpio X in pre-production at second hyperscaler; 2027 growth vectors include NPO optical (2H27), custom silicon (>10 engagements), and Orion rack-scale ($100K+ ALAB content per rack). JPM bullish heading into 2027.

bullets.title: DDOG: Q3 solid beat but Q4 revenue guide missed; FY outlook raised
bullets.body: DDOG F3Q revenue $1.20B beat consensus +4.4%; op margin 27.9% beat by 650bps; EPS $0.81 beat by $0.17. F4Q revenue guidance $1.19-1.20B missed by 0.4% citing possible large customer issue. FY2026 revenue raised to $4.515-4.525B; Citi maintains Buy at $305 PT noting 10pt sequential decel in F4Q as key concern with shares up 65% YTD.

bullets.title: SHOP: Q3 near-inline, Q4 guided low-30s; AI channel +3x — 74% Buy, avg PT $177
bullets.body: SHOP revenue +31.6% y/y (missed 0.3%); Q4 guided low-30s growth with gross profit high-20s. AI channel traffic +2.6x y/y with 64% higher conversion frequency vs organic search; GMV on track to surpass $2T by end of 2026. Sell-side 74% Buy, avg PT $177.22 (24% upside); Citi PT $216, DA Davidson lowered to $180 from $200.

bullets.title: W (Wayfair): Q3 beat on revenue and EBITDA; Q4 guided HSD growth — Citi Buy, $133 PT
bullets.body: W Q3 revenue $3.42B (+9.7% y/y), ~1% above consensus; U.S. +11.4% y/y; adj. EBITDA $236M (6.9% margin) ~5% above consensus. Q4 guided HSD% growth, EBITDA margin 6-7%, gross margin 29.5-30.5%. Active customers 22.2M +4.7% y/y; AI-referred visits doubled sequentially to ~1% of traffic. Citi maintains Buy, $133 PT (~20x '27E EV/EBITDA).

bullets.title: NYT: Q3 digital subs +420K, beat on EPS and revenue; Q4 guide solid
bullets.body: NYT Q3 EPS $0.68 beat $0.64 consensus; digital subscription revenue $421.3M +14.6% y/y, beat SA estimate. Added 420K digital net subscribers q/q to 13.22M total; digital ARPU $9.93 +1.4% y/y. Q4 guidance: digital-only subs +12-15%, digital ads high-single to low-double-digit. No measurable AI agent impact on churn to date.

bullets.title: BKNG: Q3 beat across the board; Q4 guidance well below — multiple PT cuts
bullets.body: BKNG Q3 adjusted revenue $9.8B +2.7% above consensus; gross bookings $54.5B +3.5% above; room nights +6.7% vs +5.4% consensus. Q4 guided revenue +2-4% vs FS +7.0%; EBITDA flat vs FS +9.8%, citing demand moderation from Middle East disruptions and elevated airfares. FY guidance unchanged at high-single-digit growth; multiple PT decreases overnight.

bullets.title: FLUT: FY26 guidance cut ~6% EBITDA; U.S. demand resilient, Brazil write-down hits
bullets.body: Flutter Q3 revenue $3.87B missed $3.99B FS; adj. EBITDA $360M missed $426M. FY26 EBITDA guidance cut to $2.345-2.645B midpoint from $2.655B prior on unfavorable sports outcomes, Brazil provisional ban write-down, and $620M restructuring costs. U.S. OSB handle growth stronger than expected; flat U.S. marketing expected in FY27. Share repurchase paused indefinitely.

bullets.title: XYZ (Block): Q3 beat strong; CashApp +27% GP y/y; FY27 guidance ahead
bullets.body: Block Q3 gross profit +21.8% y/y, 2.5% above estimates; CashApp monetization rate 1.74% vs 1.68% estimate, GP +27.5% y/y. FY27 guidance: gross profit growth ≥15% y/y, adj. operating income margin 32%. CashApp MAU 60M. 81% Buy; RBC raises PT to $103, Citi target $115. AI revenue expected to begin Q4 2026.

bullets.title: Data center policy risk: Blue wave midterms — 58% of planned US AI buildout in affected states
bullets.body: All six key governor races went to candidates favoring data center pauses or moratoria, covering ~58% of planned U.S. AI buildout. Texas (~20% of DC buildout through 2030) now faces Batch Zero audit uncertainty and January legislative transition. Ohio ballot measures passed. MS flags EQIX, DLR, VST, SEI at risk; 22V notes HUT and WULF with contracted power as relative beneficiaries. Market viewed election as clearing event allowing compartmentalization of risk.

bullets.title: TLN: Down 5% on AI/power weakness; $1.5B ASR to settle by end of Q1 2027
bullets.body: TLN not exposed to Texas/Georgia but fell ~5% on broad data center sentiment weakness post-election. Q3 results in-line. $1.5B accelerated share repurchase expected to settle by end of Q1 2027; additional $1.5B authorized through 2028 targeting ~70% adjusted FCF return to shareholders.

bullets.title: SMCI: Citi corrects — FY27 EPS estimates raised, not cut; FY27 revenue guide $72-82B
bullets.body: Citi corrected a prior note misreading FQ4 for FY EPS on SMCI; analyst Asiya Merchant raised FY27 EPS estimates. Super Micro F1Q27 sales $19.9B (+298% y/y), massively beat $14.5-15.5B guidance; AI solutions 71% of sales. FY27 revenue guidance raised to $72-82B; 2028 tempered by power/permitting constraints.

bullets.title: QCOM/SpaceX: Starlink Mobile selects Qualcomm Dragonwing for nationwide 5G buildout — tower REITs outperform
bullets.body: SpaceX selected Qualcomm's Dragonwing Cellular Infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile U.S. terrestrial 5G network, covering tens of thousands of cell sites beginning next year — a scale rivaling major wireless carriers. Tower REITs (AMT, CCI, SBAC) outperforming on the news; Starlink likely to leverage existing macro towers rather than build new.

bullets.title: ANET/AMD/AI bull case: Dan Ives sees AI cycle in 3rd inning of 8-10 year run
bullets.body: Wedbush's Dan Ives argues AI infrastructure is in its 'third inning' with every $1 of AI capex generating $5-6 in broader tech spending. NVDA, AMD, TSM, MU core beneficiaries; PLTR a 'generational opportunity'; META and AAPL as AI gateways. Fewer than 5% of U.S. companies have strategically implemented AI, implying a long runway.

bullets.title: SWKS: Goldman reinstates at Sell, $78 PT — smartphone exposure a drag post-Qorvo merger
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs reinstated SWKS at Sell with $78 PT. The Qorvo merger (closed Oct 5) adds ~$500M in cost synergies and ~40% A&D/auto/industrial exposure, but ~60% smartphone revenue remains a structural drag. GS sees better risk/reward elsewhere in semis.

bullets.title: MCHP: Q2 consensus within guidance; options imply ~9.6% move ahead of report
bullets.body: MCHP Q2 consensus: revenue $1.61B vs guidance $1.589-1.618B; EPS $0.94 vs guidance $0.91-0.95; gross margin 66.4%. Stock +4.8% since Aug vs XLK +4.8%. Revenue beaten consensus in 14 of past 20 quarters; EPS in 16 of 20. Options imply ~9.6% move.

bullets.title: WYNN: Q3 earnings preview — consensus $1.75B revenue, options imply 10.4% move
bullets.body: WYNN consensus Q3 net revenue $1.75B (Macau $941M, Las Vegas $604M, Boston $206M); adj. Property EBITDAR $466.6M; EPS $0.52. Stock up 20.4% since Aug 4. Options imply ~10.4% post-earnings move. Reports Nov 5 at 4:30pm ET.

bullets.title: UBER/GLW: Craig Johnson technicals model sells both; favors Energy, Healthcare, Financials
bullets.body: Technical model sells UBER, GLW, BKR, GE, HWM; adds LNG, MRSH, ROP, RSG. S&P 500 ex-AI Index up 8.8% since June while GS Broad AI Index down 17.2%. S&P year-end target 7,500. Healthcare and Energy show strongest price confirmation; 71.4% of stocks remain in weekly downtrends.

bullets.title: AVT (Avnet): Massive Q1 beat and Q2 guide well above consensus on AI supply chain surge
bullets.body: Avnet Q1 revenue $10.72B vs FactSet $9.22B; EPS $3.63 vs $2.88. Q2 guided $11.1-11.4B vs $9.42B consensus; EPS $3.90-4.10 vs $2.97. AI infrastructure driving demand beyond processors into IP&E and integration work. Electronic Components operating margin targeting 5% in H2 FY27; Farnell margin expanding beyond 10%.
